scientific_integrity: Direct antipodal and local-obstruction proof with two finite verification programs; the asymptotic is mathematically proved by Bonferroni bounds, not extrapolated from finite tests. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The count is exact only for dimensions two through six, but a sharp explicit two-order asymptotic with a stated error bound holds as dimension tends to infinity. The auxiliary Clebsch open-neighborhood face count at dimension five is existing prior art, not an independently new component. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp rare-obstruction counts for strong resolving hop domination on binary cubes
